search_topic: maximal determinant of 22x22 +1/-1 matrices (Hadamard maximal determinant problem)
brief: a construction script (`construct.py`) that outputs a 22x22 matrix of +1/-1 entries; the score is log10|det| computed exactly, and the loss is log10(proven maximum 409600000000000) minus the score. Loss 0 means the proven optimum was matched
proxy_note: proven maximum: OEIS A003432 a(21)=195312500 (confirmed by Brent 2021; D-optimal designs of order 22, Chasiotis-Kounias-Farmakis 2018), |det| = 2^21 * a(21)
